input.summary: Narrow Section 6.1 non-compete on the Company to Deerskin Products only and add carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a restriction on the businesses we operate or the products we sell, so we have narrowed Section 6.1 to the named Deerskin Products that are the subject of the Site and removed the open-ended "substantially similar products/companies" language. We have also added carve-outs for our own internal development and for acquired businesses; the restriction remains in force for the term, which preserves HDI's exclusivity bargain.

ops.oldText: Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and HDI
for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet.
ops.newText: for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet. Nothing in this Section 6.1 shall restrict the Company from (i) offering or selling any products other than Deerskin Products through any channel, (ii) internally developing web sites or e-commerce capabilities, or (iii) continuing to operate any business or web site acquired by, or merged with, the Company or any of its affiliates.
